entities.name: Dirk Westphal
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dirk Westphal is a German volleyball player, a member of Germany men's national volleyball team and Iranian club Shahrdari Tabriz VC, a gold medalist of European League 2009, a bronze medalist of the World Championship 2014.
